objective: Implement the smallest fail-closed Scenario Registry selected by the M0 contract, so operators can list and select known scenarios by stable scenario_id and scenario_version while an invalid, duplicate or unsafe manifest is rejected before any run event is written.
decision_supported: Whether Issue #301 may migrate the five existing task families onto sim/registry/**, and whether the shared runtime can resolve a scenario by exact identity without a second policy or verifier implementation.
acceptance: one manifest validator serves both the CI gate and the registry, so the contract has one implementation and cannot drift
the registry loads deterministically and independently of file discovery order
a valid manifest registers and a committed registry-native manifest loads

missing required fields, unknown fields, raw control fields, policy or verifier bypass fields, unstable scenario_id, inexact scenario_version, unknown semantic actions, unknown adapters, unsafe verifier paths, out-of-vocabulary evidence_status and oversized values each raise a stable SCENARIO_* diagnostic code
a duplicate scenario_id and scenario_version pair fails closed, and distinct versions are allowed
malformed JSON, an oversized manifest, an empty root and a missing root each fail closed with a distinct code
one invalid manifest rejects the whole catalog; there is no partial catalog
resolution is exact and an ambiguous or unknown identity is refused rather than resolved to an arbitrary version
SCRIPTED_FIXTURE, NOT_EXECUTED and BLOCKED are not release eligible, and a manifest that declares a pending action reports executable false
the registry imports no ROS, Gazebo, MoveIt or hardware module and writes nothing
list and describe are deterministic and bounded, and the existing list command is unchanged
evidence: pytest transcript for tests/unit/test_scenario_registry.py with the passed count
pytest transcript for the contract gate, sim_cli and the full unit suite
sim_cli registry-list and describe stdout, including a version mismatch refusal
make scenario-check, make contract and make context-check output
stop_conditions: the change requires editing docs/architecture/scenario-contract-v1.json or the frozen public schema, which is a reviewed contract amendment rather than a registry change
the change requires migrating the legacy sim/scenarios manifests, which belongs to Issue #301
the change requires extending the shared ActionType vocabulary, which belongs to Issue #306
the change requires a new runtime dependency or any ROS, Gazebo or hardware import
a frozen scenario fixture would have to be renamed, re-seeded or re-hashed
data_classification: public repository source, documentation and test fixtures; no secrets, personal data, credentials or physical measurement data
model_policy: AI may implement the registry, the shared validator, the CLI surface and the tests; a named human Owner accepts the registry boundary, the manifest root and any change to the frozen contract
risks_and_fallbacks: the registry-native root could be mistaken for the regression corpus; fallback is that sim/registry/README.md states the split and sim/scenarios/** stays authoritative for regression runs
a single committed registry manifest could be read as migration of the five families; fallback is that only pick_place has a manifest and Issue #301 owns the rest with byte-for-byte equivalence tests
extracting the validator could change the #308 gate verdicts; fallback is that the 57 gate tests still pass unchanged against the shared module and the gate keeps exit 0 PASS, 1 FAIL and 2 INCOMPLETE
the ambiguous-id refusal could block a future caller that wants newest-wins; fallback is that the caller names the version explicitly, which is the behaviour the contract requires
rollback is a revert of this commit; the registry is additive and read-only, and no runtime path imports it yet
